About SpaceKaur.

Our founder left a comfortable life in the UK with one belief: India should build its own critical space and aerospace systems, and build them for the world.

He was soon joined by a graduate, a former Head of Department and an Assistant Professor from the Aerospace Engineering Department at IIT Madras. The idea took shape in 2025. We incorporated in February 2026 and were incubated at IIT Madras in March 2026. Within months, through sheer hard work and an exceptionally talented team, we became part of a critical project of national importance.

We are also guided by two top veteran scientists from India’s space programme.

Today we build physics based models, validated on real hardware, along with the electronics, firmware and control software that bring precision actuators to life.

And we are just getting started. We are bringing AI into this industry, using our proprietary methods to cut engineering work that takes months down to days.

Incubated at IIT Madras.
